**The build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Read either key |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag now `undefined`, not `false` | Treat unset as off |

The 8 warnings left are real deprecations. Things like `Buffer()` and `punycode`. They do not break the build. Worth a separate pass.
